description: This file implements the utility class NetListMergeUtil which provides static methods for reading files, writing results to files, verifying file existence, and validating string sections for balanced parentheses. The class seems to be a helper utility for merging or processing network list data within the rusefi project.

classes.name: NetListMergeUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for file operations and string validation related to network list merging processes.

methods.name: writeResult
methods.description: Writes the specified content to a file with the given filename, logging the action.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a String, after verifying that the file exists.

methods.name: checkExistence
methods.description: Checks if a file exists; if not, outputs an error and terminates the program.

methods.name: validateSection
methods.description: Checks if a given section string has balanced parentheses; throws an exception if invalid.
